Horne is on for Bissett and from point blank range his shot is blocked. Then Louie Slough 's powerful snap -shot is saved by the keeper's.legs

47"
Woods heads over from a set piece, as Tivvy make a strong start to the second half. 0-0

posts.author: Darren · Facebook Fans group
posts.text:
Half time: Supermarine 0 Tiverton 0
Little between the sides. Lots of good football and endeavour, but no end product as yet. Tivvy were forced into an early change, as Jagger Cane couldn't continue and Bissett came on.

A close range effort from Marine grazes the post.
0-0

33" corner Tivvy
From it Winter gets a second bite of the cherry and as the ball comes back out of the area, Jacob Wellington volleys back over his shoulder, but also back over the bar
0-0

25" early substitution
An injury to Jagger Cane who is replaced by Josh Bissett. Hall is in round the back, offside flag is raised.
0-0

posts.author: Darren · Facebook Fans group
posts.text:
Scary moment for Supermarine
A Jagger Cane strike from the edge of the area looks to have been caught by Halliday, but it comes of the top of his fingers and is just retrieved by him on the goal-line.
Then down the other end some smart handling from Smith, keeps the door closed, Supermarine were almost in. Hotly contested game this

10"
High tempo opening. Both teams zipping it about. An Aaron Wellington free kick forced Halliday into an earlier parried save.
